subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI discard an otherwise valid bootstrap configuration after 15 seconds and continue with defaults?
rationale: The hard deadline changes existing behavior for slow deployments and can suppress server-provided bootstrap metadata; repository evidence does not establish that 15 seconds is an accepted product contract.

options.title: Accept the 15-second cutoff
options.body: Approve the fixed deadline after confirming that fallback defaults are safe for every bootstrap metadata field and supported deployment.

options.title: Choose another deadline
options.body: Set an owner-approved timeout derived from the supported reverse-proxy and deployment latency contract, then update the proof accordingly.

options.title: Pause pending reproduction
options.body: Do not introduce a cutoff until an unpatched actual-Control-UI scenario demonstrates a meaningful stalled or unusable state.

recommendation.title: Accept the 15-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Approve the fixed deadline after confirming that fallback defaults are safe for every bootstrap metadata field and supported deployment.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the authenticated bootstrap and retry behavior whose latency and fallback contract this PR changes.
